preconditions.description: The number of castles is between 1 and 40, inclusive.
The amount of liquid is between 1 and 1000 liters.

preconditions.expression: ai, j == aj, i for all 1 <= i, j <= n
ai, i == 0 for all 1 <= i <= n
preconditions.description: No castle is connected to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number.
The absolute or relative error of the output does not exceed 10^-6.
